results.title: Roles and permissions reference | Migrate to Virtual Machines | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: To configure the target details of the Compute Engine instance on the target project, the user account you use to sign in on the Google Cloud console requires: The role roles/compute.viewer on the target project · Note: If your environment uses a Shared VPC, then the user account also requires this permission on the Shared VPC host project. See Configuring permissions on host project default service account for instructions on setting these permissions. Migrate to Virtual Machines creates a default service account on the host project when you enable the Migrate to Virtual Machines API, and assigns it the role vmmigration.serviceAgent.

results.title: Roles and permissions reference | Migrate to Virtual Machines | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: In addition, Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) includes two predefined roles that you can use to control access for users in your organization. For example, if you want to allow a user in your organization to be able to view information about a migration, but not be able to perform a migration, assign them the role roles/vmmigration.viewer. A Migrate to Virtual Machines target project defines the destination project for a Compute Engine instance running your migrated VM.
